title: Max Stock Profit With Two Transactions
statement:
Find the best profit from at most two buy-sell trades.

Contract
- `prices` is non-null and may contain fewer than two days. Prices are non-negative `int` values.
- You may complete at most two transactions. A transaction is one buy followed later by one sell, and you may not hold more than one share at a time.
- Return `0` when no profitable trade exists. Do not mutate `prices`.

Examples
- `maxProfit(new int[]{3, 3, 5, 0, 0, 3, 1, 4})` returns `6`.
- `maxProfit(new int[]{7, 6, 4, 3, 1})` returns `0`.
hints: For one transaction, track the lowest earlier price and the best profit so far.
Compute best profit ending on or before each day and best profit starting on or after each day.
Try every split day between the first and second trade, combining the two precomputed profits.
